about: A proxy that sits in front of a website or app and makes people log in through Google, Azure or another identity provider first.

prs.title: Links with a query no longer loop on the trailing slash redirect
prs.broken: When a link to a folder had no ending slash but did have a query, the proxy added the slash after the query. The path never got fixed, so browsers stopped with too many redirects.
prs.changed: The slash now goes on the path, before the query, so the second request succeeds.
prs.matters: People following these links reach the page instead of a browser error.
